title: ArmorNotifier
description: Mod warns that your armor will break soon
body:
# ArmorNotifier

**Never forget to repair your armor again!**

ArmorNotifier is a lightweight utility mod that warns you in chat when your armor durability drops below 15%. Stay prepared and never let your armor break in the middle of a fight!

---

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic Durability Check** — Scans your armor every 5 seconds
- **Chat Warnings** — Sends colored warning messages when armor is about to break
- **Exact Numbers** — Shows remaining durability and percentage for each piece
- **Smart Notifications** — Warns only once per armor piece until repaired
- **Lightweight** — No GUI, no configs, just works out of the box
- **Multiplayer Compatible** — Works on servers and singleplayer

---

## ⚠️ Warning Messages

When your armor drops below **15% durability**, you'll see:

> **WARNING!** 🥾 Boots is about to break!
> Durability left: **45/300** (15.0%)
> Repair it as soon as possible!

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install **Minecraft Forge 1.12.2** (version 14.23.5.2859 or higher)
2. Download the mod `.jar` file
3. Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
4. Launch the game with Forge profile
5. Done! The mod works automatically

---

## 🔧 Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.12.2
- **Mod Loader:** Forge 14.23.5.2859+
- **Client/Server:** Client-side only
- **Conflicts:** None known

---

## 📋 Supported Armor

✅ All vanilla armor (Leather, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Chainmail)
✅ Armor from other mods (if they use standard durability system)
✅ Any item in armor slots with durability

---

## 🎯 Why Use ArmorNotifier?

- Stop losing expensive enchanted armor
- Perfect for hardcore mode
- Essential for long mining sessions
- Great for PvP and PvE combat
- Never waste resources on emergency repairs
